'''ML-T2''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that worked as a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It maintained a shop in the [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] market, where it constructed and sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
ML-T2 was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. ML-T2 appears in Anchorhead, the Republic-only [[City/Legends|city]] on Tatooine, as an Armormech Crew Skill Trainer.<ref name="TOR" />
